key: future wars - time travellers (1989)(u. s. gold)[cr bz&a](disk 1 of 2)/Future Wars - Time Travellers (1989)(U. S. Gold)[cr BZ&A](Disk 1 of 2).adf:delphine:0:DA46

key: future wars - time travellers (1989)(u. s. gold)[cr bz&a](disk 1 of 2)/Future Wars - Time Travellers (1989)(U. S. Gold)[cr BZ&A](Disk 1 of 2).adf:delphine:0:DA64

key: future wars - time travellers (1989)(u. s. gold)[cr bz&a](disk 1 of 2)/Future Wars - Time Travellers (1989)(U. S. Gold)[cr BZ&A](Disk 1 of 2).adf:delphine:0:DB16
name: poll_three_status_stages
description: Runs three successive polling loops over routine results, each waiting until the low two status bits are set, and returns the value from the final poll. It is the same staged pattern as the three-stage wait routine in this bundle, without the initial call.

key: future wars - time travellers (1989)(u. s. gold)[cr bz&a](disk 1 of 2)/Future Wars - Time Travellers (1989)(U. S. Gold)[cr BZ&A](Disk 1 of 2).adf:delphine:0:DB38
name: poll_status_with_nested_waits
description: Repeatedly polls a routine for a status value and, once the value's low two bits are clear, runs two further polling loops before returning the final result. The loop exits when the status word is zero.

key: future wars - time travellers (1989)(u. s. gold)[cr bz&a](disk 1 of 2)/Future Wars - Time Travellers (1989)(U. S. Gold)[cr BZ&A](Disk 1 of 2).adf:delphine:0:DB72
name: poll_status_then_return_value
description: Polls a routine until the low two bits of its value are clear, runs one more polling loop, and returns the value from the last poll.

key: future wars - time travellers (1989)(u. s. gold)[cr bz&a](disk 1 of 2)/Future Wars - Time Travellers (1989)(U. S. Gold)[cr BZ&A](Disk 1 of 2).adf:delphine:0:DBAC
name: poll_until_stored_flag_clears
description: Repeats a routine poll while a stored flag word is non-zero and returns the high word of the stored value or the low bits of the last poll.

key: future wars - time travellers (1989)(u. s. gold)[cr bz&a](disk 1 of 2)/Future Wars - Time Travellers (1989)(U. S. Gold)[cr BZ&A](Disk 1 of 2).adf:delphine:0:DBFA
name: open_dos_library_resources
description: Waits for two global flags to clear, then opens dos.library through the exec base and records the library pointer and a second handle. It sets a global flag once the library has opened.

key: future wars - time travellers (1989)(u. s. gold)[cr bz&a](disk 1 of 2)/Future Wars - Time Travellers (1989)(U. S. Gold)[cr BZ&A](Disk 1 of 2).adf:delphine:0:DCBA
name: examine_file_info_field
description: Allocates a file-info block, locks a file, examines it into the block, and reads a 32-bit field at a fixed offset in that block. It then unlocks the file, frees the block and returns the field.

key: future wars - time travellers (1989)(u. s. gold)[cr bz&a](disk 1 of 2)/Future Wars - Time Travellers (1989)(U. S. Gold)[cr BZ&A](Disk 1 of 2).adf:delphine:0:DD36
name: set_global_flag_to_one
description: Stores the value one into a global flag word and returns. It has no other effect.

key: future wars - time travellers (1989)(u. s. gold)[cr bz&a](disk 1 of 2)/Future Wars - Time Travellers (1989)(U. S. Gold)[cr BZ&A](Disk 1 of 2).adf:delphine:0:DD48
name: wait_for_handshake_flag
description: Sets a global flag to one if it is zero, then busy-waits until a flag word reaches the value sixty-four. It returns once that value is reached.

key: future wars - time travellers (1989)(u. s. gold)[cr bz&a](disk 1 of 2)/Future Wars - Time Travellers (1989)(U. S. Gold)[cr BZ&A](Disk 1 of 2).adf:delphine:0:DD6C
name: initialize_cia_resource
description: Opens the ciaa.resource through the exec base when it has not been fetched, then clears two state words and copies a byte and a word from a device structure. It fills a fifteen-entry table with running totals of a second table and sets an initialization flag.

key: future wars - time travellers (1989)(u. s. gold)[cr bz&a](disk 1 of 2)/Future Wars - Time Travellers (1989)(U. S. Gold)[cr BZ&A](Disk 1 of 2).adf:delphine:0:DE12
name: close_device_when_flagged
description: When a global flag is set, calls a routine through the library base at a fixed offset, calls a second routine, and clears the flag. It returns without action when the flag is zero.

key: future wars - time travellers (1989)(u. s. gold)[cr bz&a](disk 1 of 2)/Future Wars - Time Travellers (1989)(U. S. Gold)[cr BZ&A](Disk 1 of 2).adf:delphine:0:DE42
name: free_memory_if_allocated
description: When two global variables are both non-zero, calls exec.FreeMem through the exec base and clears one of the flags. Otherwise it returns without action.

key: future wars - time travellers (1989)(u. s. gold)[cr bz&a](disk 1 of 2)/Future Wars - Time Travellers (1989)(U. S. Gold)[cr BZ&A](Disk 1 of 2).adf:delphine:0:DE76

description: Scans a count-limited run of bytes from a table in the shared state block and keeps the largest value seen. It returns that maximum plus one, shifted left by ten bits, together with the input register.

key: future wars - time travellers (1989)(u. s. gold)[cr bz&a](disk 1 of 2)/Future Wars - Time Travellers (1989)(U. S. Gold)[cr BZ&A](Disk 1 of 2).adf:delphine:0:DEAA
name: write_cia_timer_control
description: Stores a fixed control value into a CIA-A register variable, then stores a value read from RAM into the same variable and copies it into a third variable. The facts list the CIA-A control and timer high and low registers as touched.

key: future wars - time travellers (1989)(u. s. gold)[cr bz&a](disk 1 of 2)/Future Wars - Time Travellers (1989)(U. S. Gold)[cr BZ&A](Disk 1 of 2).adf:delphine:0:DEC8
name: clear_pointer_table_entries
description: Writes zero to fifteen longword values, each addressed through successive entries of a pointer table held in a global variable. The table is walked in order from first to last.

key: future wars - time travellers (1989)(u. s. gold)[cr bz&a](disk 1 of 2)/Future Wars - Time Travellers (1989)(U. S. Gold)[cr BZ&A](Disk 1 of 2).adf:delphine:0:DEDA
name: reset_audio_channel_volumes
description: Sets a state word to all ones, writes zero to the four audio channel volume registers, and clears three audio state words. It does not touch the channel address or length registers.

key: future wars - time travellers (1989)(u. s. gold)[cr bz&a](disk 1 of 2)/Future Wars - Time Travellers (1989)(U. S. Gold)[cr BZ&A](Disk 1 of 2).adf:delphine:0:DF0C
name: initialize_audio_channel_registers
description: Zeroes the four audio channel volume registers and sets each channel's length register to one. It points each channel's address register at the same state variable and writes a constant into that variable.

key: future wars - time travellers (1989)(u. s. gold)[cr bz&a](disk 1 of 2)/Future Wars - Time Travellers (1989)(U. S. Gold)[cr BZ&A](Disk 1 of 2).adf:delphine:0:DF5E
name: forward_call_and_return_zero
description: Calls a single routine and returns zero to its caller.

key: future wars - time travellers (1989)(u. s. gold)[cr bz&a](disk 1 of 2)/Future Wars - Time Travellers (1989)(U. S. Gold)[cr BZ&A](Disk 1 of 2).adf:delphine:0:DF64
name: tick_audio_channels_every_six
description: Counts ticks and, on every tick except the sixth, runs a routine for each of the four audio channel register blocks. On the sixth tick it resets the counter, raises a flag word up to sixty-four and calls routines that handle the end of the cycle.

key: future wars - time travellers (1989)(u. s. gold)[cr bz&a](disk 1 of 2)/Future Wars - Time Travellers (1989)(U. S. Gold)[cr BZ&A](Disk 1 of 2).adf:delphine:0:DFA8
name: call_routine_return_stack_value
description: Calls a routine and then returns the eight-byte value found in the caller's stack frame.

key: future wars - time travellers (1989)(u. s. gold)[cr bz&a](disk 1 of 2)/Future Wars - Time Travellers (1989)(U. S. Gold)[cr BZ&A](Disk 1 of 2).adf:delphine:0:DFB2
name: process_four_audio_channels
description: Calls a routine four times, once for each audio channel register block, stepping sixteen bytes between blocks and passing the channel index in decreasing order.

key: future wars - time travellers (1989)(u. s. gold)[cr bz&a](disk 1 of 2)/Future Wars - Time Travellers (1989)(U. S. Gold)[cr BZ&A](Disk 1 of 2).adf:delphine:0:DFE4

description: Runs one step of a channel sequencer. A non-zero step word is added to a running value and clamped against a limit, while a zero step word reads a command nibble that dispatches through a jump table, adjusts a value, sets or clears a flag bit, or looks up a table entry.

key: future wars - time travellers (1989)(u. s. gold)[cr bz&a](disk 1 of 2)/Future Wars - Time Travellers (1989)(U. S. Gold)[cr BZ&A](Disk 1 of 2).adf:delphine:0:E006
name: add_delta_with_minimum_clamp
description: Adds a delta word to a running value and raises the result to at least a limit word. The result is stored back into the running value and into a frame slot.

key: future wars - time travellers (1989)(u. s. gold)[cr bz&a](disk 1 of 2)/Future Wars - Time Travellers (1989)(U. S. Gold)[cr BZ&A](Disk 1 of 2).adf:delphine:0:E01A
name: dispatch_channel_sequencer_command
description: Dispatches a command nibble from a channel sequence entry. Nibble one runs a jump-table handler, two adjusts a running value, three sets and four clears a flag bit, and seven or eight look up a table entry.

key: future wars - time travellers (1989)(u. s. gold)[cr bz&a](disk 1 of 2)/Future Wars - Time Travellers (1989)(U. S. Gold)[cr BZ&A](Disk 1 of 2).adf:delphine:0:E04C
name: set_cia_port_bit_two
description: Sets the bit with value two in a global variable that the decompiler links to the CIA-A port register. That register holds the fire buttons and disk status.

key: future wars - time travellers (1989)(u. s. gold)[cr bz&a](disk 1 of 2)/Future Wars - Time Travellers (1989)(U. S. Gold)[cr BZ&A](Disk 1 of 2).adf:delphine:0:E056
name: clear_cia_port_bit_two
description: Clears the bit with value two in a global variable that the decompiler links to the CIA-A port register. That register holds the fire buttons and disk status.

key: future wars - time travellers (1989)(u. s. gold)[cr bz&a](disk 1 of 2)/Future Wars - Time Travellers (1989)(U. S. Gold)[cr BZ&A](Disk 1 of 2).adf:delphine:0:E060

key: future wars - time travellers (1989)(u. s. gold)[cr bz&a](disk 1 of 2)/Future Wars - Time Travellers (1989)(U. S. Gold)[cr BZ&A](Disk 1 of 2).adf:delphine:0:E09A
name: copy_word_with_signed_offset
description: Doubles an input word and negates it when a second input is zero, then copies the word at that offset from a source address into a field of a record.

name: store_word_into_record_field
description: Stores the word from the input register into a record field at a fixed offset.

key: future wars - time travellers (1989)(u. s. gold)[cr bz&a](disk 1 of 2)/Future Wars - Time Travellers (1989)(U. S. Gold)[cr BZ&A](Disk 1 of 2).adf:delphine:0:E0B2
name: decode_signed_sequence_entry
description: Stores a negated low nibble and the event word into a channel sequence record. It then searches a table ending with an all-ones terminator and stores the matched value at a nibble-scaled offset, or the event word when no entry matches.

key: future wars - time travellers (1989)(u. s. gold)[cr bz&a](disk 1 of 2)/Future Wars - Time Travellers (1989)(U. S. Gold)[cr BZ&A](Disk 1 of 2).adf:delphine:0:E0B6
name: dispatch_command_via_table
description: Calls a handler selected from a jump table by the current tick counter minus one. It returns after that handler finishes.

key: future wars - time travellers (1989)(u. s. gold)[cr bz&a](disk 1 of 2)/Future Wars - Time Travellers (1989)(U. S. Gold)[cr BZ&A](Disk 1 of 2).adf:delphine:0:E0CE

description: Searches a table in the state block for the entry that matches a word field of the record, then stores the table value at the index given by the input register into a frame slot.

key: future wars - time travellers (1989)(u. s. gold)[cr bz&a](disk 1 of 2)/Future Wars - Time Travellers (1989)(U. S. Gold)[cr BZ&A](Disk 1 of 2).adf:delphine:0:E0E8
name: lookup_entry_by_high_nibble
description: Searches the state table for the entry matching a word field of the record, then stores the table value selected by the high nibble of the record's third byte into a frame slot.

key: future wars - time travellers (1989)(u. s. gold)[cr bz&a](disk 1 of 2)/Future Wars - Time Travellers (1989)(U. S. Gold)[cr BZ&A](Disk 1 of 2).adf:delphine:0:E0F2
name: lookup_entry_by_low_nibble
description: Searches the state table for the entry matching a word field of the record, then stores the table value selected by the low nibble of the record's third byte into a frame slot.

key: future wars - time travellers (1989)(u. s. gold)[cr bz&a](disk 1 of 2)/Future Wars - Time Travellers (1989)(U. S. Gold)[cr BZ&A](Disk 1 of 2).adf:delphine:0:E0FE
name: copy_record_word_to_frame
description: Copies the word at a fixed offset in the record into a frame slot.

key: future wars - time travellers (1989)(u. s. gold)[cr bz&a](disk 1 of 2)/Future Wars - Time Travellers (1989)(U. S. Gold)[cr BZ&A](Disk 1 of 2).adf:delphine:0:E108
name: adjust_word_by_nibble
description: Adds the high nibble of the record's third byte to a word field when that nibble is non-zero. When it is zero, subtracts the low nibble, and stores the new value into a frame slot.

key: future wars - time travellers (1989)(u. s. gold)[cr bz&a](disk 1 of 2)/Future Wars - Time Travellers (1989)(U. S. Gold)[cr BZ&A](Disk 1 of 2).adf:delphine:0:E11E
name: decrement_word_by_nibble
description: Subtracts the low nibble of the record's third byte from a word field when that nibble is non-zero, and stores the result into a frame slot.

key: future wars - time travellers (1989)(u. s. gold)[cr bz&a](disk 1 of 2)/Future Wars - Time Travellers (1989)(U. S. Gold)[cr BZ&A](Disk 1 of 2).adf:delphine:0:E28E

key: future wars - time travellers (1989)(u. s. gold)[cr bz&a](disk 1 of 2)/Future Wars - Time Travellers (1989)(U. S. Gold)[cr BZ&A](Disk 1 of 2).adf:delphine:0:E2CA

key: future wars - time travellers (1989)(u. s. gold)[cr bz&a](disk 1 of 2)/Future Wars - Time Travellers (1989)(U. S. Gold)[cr BZ&A](Disk 1 of 2).adf:delphine:0:E2F8

description: When a record's status word is non-zero, stores the status, waits a short delay, and clears the record when the status is minus two. Otherwise it writes the record's address and length fields, then ORs the record's DMA bit into the active mask.

key: future wars - time travellers (1989)(u. s. gold)[cr bz&a](disk 1 of 2)/Future Wars - Time Travellers (1989)(U. S. Gold)[cr BZ&A](Disk 1 of 2).adf:delphine:0:E322
name: store_fields_and_or_flag
description: Copies a longword and two words from a source record into a destination structure, then ORs the source's flag word into a global mask.

key: future wars - time travellers (1989)(u. s. gold)[cr bz&a](disk 1 of 2)/Future Wars - Time Travellers (1989)(U. S. Gold)[cr BZ&A](Disk 1 of 2).adf:delphine:0:E3E6
name: call_two_routines_undecompiled

key: future wars - time travellers (1989)(u. s. gold)[cr bz&a](disk 1 of 2)/Future Wars - Time Travellers (1989)(U. S. Gold)[cr BZ&A](Disk 1 of 2).adf:delphine:0:E46A

key: future wars - time travellers (1989)(u. s. gold)[cr bz&a](disk 1 of 2)/Future Wars - Time Travellers (1989)(U. S. Gold)[cr BZ&A](Disk 1 of 2).adf:delphine:0:E4C2
name: call_one_routine_undecompiled
description: The decompiler timed out, so no pseudo-code is available. The facts show seven instructions that make one routine call and are referenced from hunk 0 data, so the purpose of the routine is unknown.

name: clear_sequence_table_and_reinit
description: Zeroes the first word of a sequence table referenced from the record and the table's last entry. It then calls a routine twice, once with all-ones and sixty-three and once with one and zero.

name: open_cia_resource_once
description: On the first call, opens the ciaa.resource through the exec base, stores its pointer, and calls a library function at offset minus six through it. It then sets a flag so later calls do nothing.

key: future wars - time travellers (1989)(u. s. gold)[cr bz&a](disk 1 of 2)/Future Wars - Time Travellers (1989)(U. S. Gold)[cr BZ&A](Disk 1 of 2).adf:delphine:0:E59A
name: release_cia_resource_if_open
description: When the CIA resource flag is set, calls a routine through the resource base at a fixed offset, calls a second routine, and clears the flag. It returns without action when the flag is zero.

key: future wars - time travellers (1989)(u. s. gold)[cr bz&a](disk 1 of 2)/Future Wars - Time Travellers (1989)(U. S. Gold)[cr BZ&A](Disk 1 of 2).adf:delphine:0:E5C8
name: write_cia_timer_registers
description: Stores a fixed control value into a CIA-A register variable, then stores a value read from RAM into it and copies it again. The facts list the CIA-A control and timer high and low registers as touched.

key: future wars - time travellers (1989)(u. s. gold)[cr bz&a](disk 1 of 2)/Future Wars - Time Travellers (1989)(U. S. Gold)[cr BZ&A](Disk 1 of 2).adf:delphine:0:E5E6
name: clear_audio_pointers_and_counters
description: Writes zero to the four audio channel volume registers and points the four channel address registers at a shared state variable. It also zeroes four state counters in RAM.

key: future wars - time travellers (1989)(u. s. gold)[cr bz&a](disk 1 of 2)/Future Wars - Time Travellers (1989)(U. S. Gold)[cr BZ&A](Disk 1 of 2).adf:delphine:0:E62A
name: reset_audio_pointers_and_counters
description: Zeroes the four audio channel volume registers, points the four channel address registers at a shared state variable, and sets that variable to fifteen. It then zeroes four state counters.

key: future wars - time travellers (1989)(u. s. gold)[cr bz&a](disk 1 of 2)/Future Wars - Time Travellers (1989)(U. S. Gold)[cr BZ&A](Disk 1 of 2).adf:delphine:0:E674
name: call_routine_return_input
description: Calls a single routine and returns the input register value unchanged.

key: future wars - time travellers (1989)(u. s. gold)[cr bz&a](disk 1 of 2)/Future Wars - Time Travellers (1989)(U. S. Gold)[cr BZ&A](Disk 1 of 2).adf:delphine:0:E682
name: advance_audio_channel_schedule
description: Counts ticks, running a routine for each of the four audio channels on every tick up to six.
